messages:
alex: quick ux check — noticed a few mismatches between the inline docs panel and console copy. small stuff but it's confusing for new users :grimacing: alex: e.g. we show 'Route' in the sidebar but the docs use 'Path' and some examples say 'Endpoint'. users are wondering if those are different concepts. tess: +1 saw this in the onboarding funnel too. could we pick one canonical term and make the in-product docs show the mapping? :eyes: jun: putting a mapping table in the docs is fine, but can we also add anchors so the inlay links jump to the exact heading? right now they land at top of page and you lose context. maria: accessibility nit — the small inlay help widget is not reachable by keyboard tab in some pages (hit during an audit). the close "x" has no aria-label, screenreader only reads "button". alex: good catch. @jun can we also add focus trap and tabindex for the panel? should be tabbable and close via esc. jun: yes i can take keyboard focus and aria-label. i'll add: role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Contextual help" and ensure focus goes to the first heading. sam: for the terminology sync, suggest this flow: 1) pick canonical term in product docs 2) create a short glossary snippet used by console microcopy 3) add "see also" anchors to full doc page. avoids duplicating long text. alex: love that. also microcopy tweak: change "Model version" tooltip to "Model version (immutable snapshot)" — had a customer confusion where they thought version implied dynamic rollout. maria: another small one — the link color in the inlay has low contrast on the dark theme. contrast check fails at 3:1. current hex is #5aa3ff. needs to be darker or underlined. alex: can we produce a tiny PR with: mapping table, anchor targets, aria labels, and color token tweak? call it: docs/ux/inlay-term-sync. i'll add acceptance criteria in the PR description. jun: i'll open the PR tomorrow. sample anchor suggestion in case helpful: ``

Batching & Caching

...

Jump to batching ``` tess: also thinking about a microcopy registry for single-source-of-truth strings — makes it easier for docs/devs to stay in sync. sam: +1. small YAML file with keys like `term.route` `term.path` `term.endpoint` and translations for surfaces. keeps console and docs consistent. docs-bot: reminder — please add a CHANGELOG entry when you push the glossary mapping (for audit). alex: thanks everyone. i'll create a tiny design doc with examples and link it in the PR. if anyone has an example of confusing phrasing from support, drop it here or DM me. :thumbsup:
